clauses: Average each patient's HGB/HCT ratios across their lab tests.
Divide each patient's average HGB by their average HCT.
readings: Work out each patient's hemoglobin-to-hematocrit (`HGB`/`HCT`) ratio based on their lab tests. Keep the patients whose ratio is above the average across all patients, noting how far above they are. Then, within that group, keep those who are also above the group's own average, noting how far above that they are. Give one row with the averages, over these final patients, of the ratio, the amount above the overall average, and the amount above the group average, unrounded. Average each patient's HGB/HCT ratios across their lab tests.

Work out each patient's hemoglobin-to-hematocrit (`HGB`/`HCT`) ratio based on their lab tests. Keep the patients whose ratio is above the average across all patients, noting how far above they are. Then, within that group, keep those who are also above the group's own average, noting how far above that they are. Give one row with the averages, over these final patients, of the ratio, the amount above the overall average, and the amount above the group average, unrounded. Divide each patient's average HGB by their average HCT.
queries:
WITH patient_ratios AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB / HCT) AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM patient_ratios
),
above_overall AS (
    SELECT p.ratio, p.ratio - o.avg_ratio AS above_overall
    FROM patient_ratios AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
    WHERE p.ratio > o.avg_ratio
),
group_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM above_overall
)
SELECT
    AVG(a.ratio) AS avg_ratio,
    AVG(a.above_overall) AS avg_above_overall,
    AVG(a.ratio - g.avg_ratio) AS avg_above_group
FROM above_overall AS a
CROSS JOIN group_average AS g
WHERE a.ratio > g.avg_ratio

WITH patient_ratios AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) / NULLIF(AVG(HCT), 0) AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM patient_ratios
),
above_overall AS (
    SELECT p.ratio, p.ratio - o.avg_ratio AS above_overall
    FROM patient_ratios AS p
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
    WHERE p.ratio > o.avg_ratio
),
group_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
    FROM above_overall
)
SELECT
    AVG(a.ratio) AS avg_ratio,
    AVG(a.above_overall) AS avg_above_overall,
    AVG(a.ratio - g.avg_ratio) AS avg_above_group
FROM above_overall AS a
CROSS JOIN group_average AS g
WHERE a.ratio > g.avg_ratio
